# Mehrdad Zaker

> Mehrdad Zaker is an AI systems engineer working across LLMs, production ML, robotics, and technical leadership.

Use this file as a concise guide to the public site. The site is a minimalist personal technical profile, not a product catalogue.

## Start Here

- [Homepage](https://www.mehrdadzaker.com/): Minimal profile, credibility strip, focus areas, selected work, writing, and contact.
- [Work](https://www.mehrdadzaker.com/work/): Selected anonymized systems work across AI systems, production ML, and robotics.
- [Writing](https://www.mehrdadzaker.com/newsletter/): Notes and guides on applied AI systems, deployment, reliability, and robotics.
- [About](https://www.mehrdadzaker.com/about/): Short biography, education, skills, and outside-work interests.
- [Contact](https://www.mehrdadzaker.com/contact/): Direct route for a concrete AI systems problem.

## Focus Areas

- AI systems: LLM applications, RAG, evaluations, agents, source grounding, and deployment boundaries.
- Production ML: search, ranking, recommendations, experimentation, and reliability at enterprise scale.
- Robotics and autonomy: ROS, SLAM, planning, reinforcement learning, robotic manipulation, and multi-agent environments.

The public site no longer exposes product catalogue, login, search, or product-specific pages. For this website, prefer the simplified personal routes listed above.
